name: Parque Sucre (Town Center)
tagline: Filandia's colorful heart, plaza cafes and balconied houses
description: The central plaza and surrounding blocks hold Filandia's brightly painted balconied houses, artisan shops, and the town's best cafes. Everything walkable is here: guesthouses, the market, restaurants, and the church. It is the natural base for remote workers, with the most reliable wifi in town and easy access to buses and jeeps heading out to the countryside.
bestFor: first-time visitors, cafe workers, short stays
cons: Can feel busy on holiday weekends

name: Mirador Colina Iluminada Area
tagline: Hilltop lookout tower with panoramic coffee-valley views
description: A short uphill walk from the plaza, this area centers on the striking wooden Mirador Colina Iluminada tower, offering sweeping views over the green valleys of the Coffee Cultural Landscape. A handful of guesthouses and viewpoint cafes cluster nearby, popular at sunset. Quieter than the plaza itself, with a slower, scenic pace.
pros: Close enough to walk from center

name: Vereda Barcelona (Coffee Farm Country)
tagline: Rural coffee-farm hills near the Barbas-Bremen reserve
description: This rural vereda southwest of town sits amid working coffee fincas and forest bordering the Barbas-Bremen reserve, known for birdwatching and hiking trails. Some fincas offer farm stays or day tours. Roads are unpaved or winding, and this is genuine countryside living, with no cafes or shops, just farms, forest, and quiet.
cons: No wifi or shops on site

name: Salento
tagline: Nearby coffee town, livelier and more touristy than Filandia
description: About 20 to 30 minutes away by road or jeep, Salento is the coffee region's best-known town, with a busier plaza, more restaurants, tour operators, and the Valle de Cocora nearby. Many nomads base in Filandia for quiet and cost, then day-trip into Salento for its livelier atmosphere, shopping, and jeep connections to the wax palm valley.
bestFor: day trips, hiking Cocora, more dining variety
pros: Wider range of restaurants and shops
Gateway to Valle de Cocora hikes
cons: More crowded and pricier than Filandia
